decisions.reason: The flagship transactional email service draws on the firm's core messaging expertise, data centers and own R&D, so the firm can read its results and keep improving it in line with its multichannel cloud direction.
Email-fax conversion uses long-held channel integration know-how and still serves regulated customers who rely on fax, though fax demand is slowly declining.
This feature sits very close to the established fax service and costs little to maintain, but it may be folded into the base offering as fax volumes shrink.
Sandbox threat protection builds on the firm's email security knowledge, which lets it absorb new threat information and keep improving the product as security demand grows.
